method.method_draft: First translate the diagram into node equations. Define x = Vtop − Vmid and y = Vmid − Vbottom, so the resistor voltage is vR = x + y. With Vin = 100 sin(ωt), ω = 100π. Otherwise both capacitors discharge through R, with the off-state evolution proportional to −(x+y)/(RC). Numerically or analytically iterate these equations until periodic steady state using ωRC = 50, then average x+y over one cycle.
